theorem mvcc.kiIsEmpty_eq (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : mvcc.kiIsEmpty ki = decide (ki.gens.length = 1 ∧
    (ki.gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty).revs = [])

def mvcc.cmpRevIdx (c : w64) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : Nat :=
  (mvcc.genWalk (ki.gens.getD (mvcc.compactGenIdx c ki.gens) mvcc.Gen.empty).revs (mvcc.pAbove c)).toNat

    (mvcc.stepO ev o')

def mvcc.CutPos (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (gi j : Nat) : Prop :=
  gi < ki.gens.length ∧
    (j < (ki.gens.getD gi mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.length ∨ (ki.gens.getD gi mvcc.Gen.empty).revs = [] ∧ j = 0)

def mvcc.IdxCRepN (cmax : Int) (evs : List mvcc.Ev) (idx : mvcc.IndexM) : Prop :=
  List.Pairwise mvcc.idxLess idx ∧
    ∀ (k : GoString),
      ∃ c,
        -1 ≤ c ∧
          c ≤ cmax ∧
            ∃ gi j,
              mvcc.CutLe (W64 c) (mvcc.kiOfKey evs k) gi j ∧
                Option.map mvcc.kiNorm (mvcc.idxGet idx k) =
                  Option.map mvcc.kiNorm (mvcc.kiCutO gi j (mvcc.kiOfKey evs k))

theorem mvcc.kiCutAt_gens_ne {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} {gi j : Nat} (h : mvcc.CutPos ki gi j) :
    (mvcc.kiCutAt gi j ki).gens ≠ []

def mvcc.CutLe (c : w64) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (gi j : Nat) : Prop :=
  gi < mvcc.compactGenIdx c ki.gens ∧ j < (ki.gens.getD gi mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.length ∨
    gi = mvcc.compactGenIdx c ki.gens ∧ j ≤ mvcc.cmpRevIdx c ki

    ki gi j) : (mvcc.kiCutAt gi j ki).gens ≠ [] ∧ ∀ (i : Nat), i + 1 < (mvcc.kiCutAt gi j
    ki).gens.length → ((mvcc.kiCutAt gi j ki).gens.getD i mvcc.Gen.empty).revs ≠ []

    (mvcc.evsOf log) (if mvcc.kiIsEmpty (mvcc.kiCompact (W64 c') ki) = true then List.eraseIdx idx i
    else List.set idx i (k, mvcc.kiCompact (W64 c') ki))

    (mvcc.kiCompact c ki).gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty = if mvcc.compactGenIdx c ki.gens + 1 =

    := a, revs := g.revs } = have __src := mvcc.cutGen c g; { ver := b, created := a, revs :=

theorem mvcc.kiNorm_getD (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (i : Nat) : (mvcc.kiNorm ki).gens.getD i
    mvcc.Gen.empty = if i + 1 < ki.gens.length then mvcc.genNorm (ki.gens.getD i mvcc.Gen.empty)
    else ki.gens.getD i mvcc.Gen.empty

    : Nat), i < l.length → l.getD i d = l'.getD i d) : l = l'

def mvcc.kiCutO (gi j : Nat) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : Option mvcc.KeyIndex :=
  if mvcc.kiIsEmpty (mvcc.kiCutAt gi j ki) = true then none else some (mvcc.kiCutAt gi j ki)

    mvcc.CutLe c ki gi j) : gi ≤ mvcc.compactGenIdx c ki.gens ∧ gi < ki.gens.length ∧ (j <
    (ki.gens.getD gi mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.length ∨ (ki.gens.getD gi mvcc.Gen.empty).revs = [] ∧ j =
    0)

    List.drop gi (ki.gens.set gi (mvcc.genDrop j (ki.gens.getD gi mvcc.Gen.empty)))

    mvcc.IndexM} (h : mvcc.IdxCRepN cmax (mvcc.evsOf log) idx) {k1 k2 : GoString} {ki1 ki2 :
    mvcc.KeyIndex} {c : w64} {r : mvcc.Rev} (h1 : mvcc.idxGet idx k1 = some ki1) (h2 : mvcc.idxGet
    idx k2 = some ki2) (hr1 : mvcc.kiAvail c ki1 = some r) (hr2 : mvcc.kiAvail c ki2 = some r) : k1
    = k2

def mvcc.stepO (ev : mvcc.Ev) (o : Option mvcc.KeyIndex) : Option mvcc.KeyIndex :=
  match o with
  | some ki' =>
    if ev.tomb = true then if mvcc.kiLastEmpty ki' = true then some ki' else some (mvcc.kiTombstone ki' ev.rev)
    else some (mvcc.kiPut ki' ev.rev)
  | none => if ev.tomb = true then none else some (mvcc.kiPut mvcc.KeyIndex.fresh ev.rev)

theorem mvcc.kiRevs_kiNorm (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : mvcc.kiRevs (mvcc.kiNorm ki) = mvcc.kiRevs ki

    mvcc.tombZ (mvcc.genDrop j g) = mvcc.tombZ g

    mvcc.kiLastEmpty (mvcc.kiCutAt gi j ki) = mvcc.kiLastEmpty ki

def mvcc.kiNorm (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : mvcc.KeyIndex :=
  { modified := ki.modified, gens := List.map mvcc.genNorm ki.gens.dropLast ++ ki.gens.getLast?.toList }

theorem mvcc.genDrop_revs_ne {j : Nat} {g : mvcc.Gen} (h : j < g.revs.length ∨ g.revs = [] ∧ j = 0)
    : (mvcc.genDrop j g).revs = [] ↔ g.revs = []

theorem mvcc.kiIsEmpty_kiNorm (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : mvcc.kiIsEmpty (mvcc.kiNorm ki) =
    mvcc.kiIsEmpty ki

def mvcc.genDrop (j : Nat) (g : mvcc.Gen) : mvcc.Gen :=
  { ver := g.ver, created := g.created, revs := List.drop j g.revs }

theorem mvcc.kiFindGen_kiNorm (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (a : w64) : mvcc.kiFindGen (mvcc.kiNorm ki) a =
    mvcc.kiFindGen ki a

theorem mvcc.idxGet_idxApply {idx : mvcc.IndexM} (hs : List.Pairwise mvcc.idxLess idx) (ev :
    mvcc.Ev) (k : GoString) : mvcc.idxGet (mvcc.idxApply idx ev) k = if ev.key = k then mvcc.stepO
    ev (mvcc.idxGet idx k) else mvcc.idxGet idx k

theorem mvcc.cutGen_eq_genDrop (c : w64) (g : mvcc.Gen) : mvcc.cutGen c g = mvcc.genDrop
    (mvcc.genWalk g.revs (mvcc.pAbove c)).toNat g

theorem mvcc.kiCutAt_appendEmpty {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} {gi j : Nat} (hlt : gi < ki.gens.length) :
    mvcc.kiCutAt gi j { modified := ki.modified, gens := ki.gens ++ [mvcc.Gen.empty] } = have __src
    := mvcc.kiCutAt gi j ki; { modified := __src.modified, gens := (mvcc.kiCutAt gi j ki).gens ++
    [mvcc.Gen.empty] }

theorem mvcc.kiCompactO_eq_cutO (c : Int) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : mvcc.kiCompactO c ki = mvcc.kiCutO
    (mvcc.compactGenIdx (W64 c) ki.gens) (mvcc.cmpRevIdx (W64 c) ki) ki

theorem mvcc.kiGet_cutAt {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hs : mvcc.KiS ki) {c a : w64} (hca : sint.Z c ≤
    sint.Z a) {gi j : Nat} (h : mvcc.CutLe c ki gi j) : mvcc.kiGet (mvcc.kiCutAt gi j ki) a =
    mvcc.kiGet ki a

theorem mvcc.compactGenIdx_kiNorm (c : w64) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : mvcc.compactGenIdx c (mvcc.kiNorm
    ki).gens = mvcc.compactGenIdx c ki.gens

theorem mvcc.findAux_cutAt {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hs : mvcc.KiS ki) {c a : w64} (hca : sint.Z c ≤
    sint.Z a) {gi j : Nat} (h : mvcc.CutLe c ki gi j) (t : Nat) : t < ki.gens.length - gi →
    mvcc.kiFindGenAux (mvcc.kiCutAt gi j ki).gens a (t + 1) = Option.map (fun x => x - gi)
    (mvcc.kiFindGenAux ki.gens a (gi + t + 1)) ∧ ∀ (x : Nat), mvcc.kiFindGenAux ki.gens a (gi + t +
    1) = some x → gi ≤ x

theorem mvcc.kiCutAt_modified (gi j : Nat) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : (mvcc.kiCutAt gi j ki).modified =
    ki.modified

theorem mvcc.IdxCRepN.avail_some {cmax : Int} {log : mvcc.Log} (hb : mvcc.LogB log) {idx :
    mvcc.IndexM} (h : mvcc.IdxCRepN cmax (mvcc.evsOf log) idx) (c : Int) (hc : cmax ≤ c) (hc' : c <
    2 ^ 63) {k : GoString} {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hg : mvcc.idxGet idx k = some ki) : mvcc.kiAvail
    (W64 c) ki = mvcc.kiAvail (W64 c) (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log) k)

theorem mvcc.kiNorm_map_revs (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : List.map mvcc.Gen.revs (mvcc.kiNorm ki).gens =
    List.map mvcc.Gen.revs ki.gens

theorem mvcc.compactGenIdx_congrRevs (c : w64) (G G' : List mvcc.Gen) : List.map mvcc.Gen.revs G =
    List.map mvcc.Gen.revs G' → mvcc.compactGenIdx c G = mvcc.compactGenIdx c G'

theorem mvcc.kiNorm_length (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : (mvcc.kiNorm ki).gens.length = ki.gens.length

theorem mvcc.genDrop_genPut {j : Nat} {g : mvcc.Gen} (hj : j < g.revs.length ∨ g.revs = [] ∧ j = 0)
    (rev : mvcc.Rev) : mvcc.genDrop j (mvcc.genPut g rev) = mvcc.genPut (mvcc.genDrop j g) rev

theorem mvcc.IdxCRepN.step (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (x : mvcc.Change) (hb :
    mvcc.LogB (ilog ++ [pend ++ [x]])) {cmax : Int} {idx : mvcc.IndexM} (hcmax : cmax <
    ↑(List.length ilog)) (h : mvcc.IdxCRepN cmax (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend])) idx) : mvcc.IdxCRepN
    cmax (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend ++ [x]])) (mvcc.idxApply idx (mvcc.evOfChange (List.length ilog)
    pend.length x))

theorem mvcc.kiLastEmpty_kiNorm (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : mvcc.kiLastEmpty (mvcc.kiNorm ki) =
    mvcc.kiLastEmpty ki

theorem mvcc.CutLe.cmp (c : w64) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : mvcc.CutLe c ki (mvcc.compactGenIdx c
    ki.gens) (mvcc.cmpRevIdx c ki)

theorem mvcc.kiNorm_kiCompact (c : w64) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : mvcc.kiNorm (mvcc.kiCompact c
    (mvcc.kiNorm ki)) = mvcc.kiNorm (mvcc.kiCompact c ki)

theorem mvcc.gensOk_kiNorm (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : ((mvcc.kiNorm ki).gens ≠ [] ∧ ∀ (i : Nat), i + 1 <
    (mvcc.kiNorm ki).gens.length → ((mvcc.kiNorm ki).gens.getD i mvcc.Gen.empty).revs ≠ []) ↔
    ki.gens ≠ [] ∧ ∀ (i : Nat), i + 1 < ki.gens.length → (ki.gens.getD i mvcc.Gen.empty).revs ≠ []

def mvcc.genNorm (g : mvcc.Gen) : mvcc.Gen :=
  if g.revs.length = 1 then { ver := W64 1, created := W64 0, revs := g.revs } else g

theorem mvcc.kiNorm_kiTombstone (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (rev : mvcc.Rev) : mvcc.kiNorm
    (mvcc.kiTombstone (mvcc.kiNorm ki) rev) = mvcc.kiNorm (mvcc.kiTombstone ki rev)

theorem mvcc.keepOf_genDrop {c' : w64} {g : mvcc.Gen} {j : Nat} (hj : ↑j ≤ mvcc.genWalk g.revs
    (mvcc.pAbove c')) (l : Prop) [Decidable l] : mvcc.keepOf c' (mvcc.genDrop j g) l = mvcc.keepOf
    c' g l

def mvcc.kiCutAt (gi j : Nat) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : mvcc.KeyIndex :=
  { modified := ki.modified, gens := List.drop gi (ki.gens.set gi (mvcc.genDrop j (ki.gens.getD gi mvcc.Gen.empty))) }

theorem mvcc.kiFindGenAux_congrRevs (gens gens' : List mvcc.Gen) (a : w64) (hl : gens.length =
    gens'.length) (hr : ∀ (i : Nat), (gens.getD i mvcc.Gen.empty).revs = (gens'.getD i
    mvcc.Gen.empty).revs) (n : Nat) : mvcc.kiFindGenAux gens a n = mvcc.kiFindGenAux gens' a n

theorem mvcc.sintZ_W64_of {c : Int} (h0 : -1 ≤ c) (h1 : c < 2 ^ 63) : sint.Z (W64 c) = c

theorem mvcc.IdxCRepN.rangeAt (log : mvcc.Log) (hb : mvcc.LogB log) {cmax : Int} {idx : mvcc.IndexM}
    (h : mvcc.IdxCRepN cmax (mvcc.evsOf log) idx) (atRev : w64) (hc : cmax ≤ sint.Z atRev) (k e :
    GoString) : mvcc.rangeAt idx k e atRev = mvcc.rangeAt (mvcc.indexOf (mvcc.evsOf log)) k e atRev

theorem mvcc.findAux_below_cut {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) {c a : w64} (hca : sint.Z c
    ≤ sint.Z a) {gi : Nat} (hgi : gi ≤ mvcc.compactGenIdx c ki.gens) : mvcc.kiFindGenAux ki.gens a
    gi = none

theorem mvcc.kiCutAt_getLastD {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} {gi j : Nat} (h : mvcc.CutPos ki gi j) :
    (mvcc.kiCutAt gi j ki).gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty = if gi + 1 = ki.gens.length then
    mvcc.genDrop j (ki.gens.getD gi mvcc.Gen.empty) else ki.gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty

theorem mvcc.genDrop_zero (g : mvcc.Gen) : mvcc.genDrop 0 g = g

theorem mvcc.kiNorm_eq_of {A B : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hm : A.modified = B.modified) (hl : A.gens.length =
    B.gens.length) (hg : ∀ (i : Nat), i + 1 < A.gens.length → mvcc.genNorm (A.gens.getD i
    mvcc.Gen.empty) = mvcc.genNorm (B.gens.getD i mvcc.Gen.empty)) (hlast : A.gens.getLastD
    mvcc.Gen.empty = B.gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty) : mvcc.kiNorm A = mvcc.kiNorm B
